events.title: Map symbol words in myth and folklore without predefined meanings
events.summary: Embed the passage around each of 20 symbol words, lay the passages out with UMAP and let HDBSCAN find groups, so any shared meaning has to come from the text.

events.title: The baseline clusters followed books, not symbols
events.summary: In the first run a cluster's largest book held 74 % of it on average, and only 5 of 43 clusters drew on several books.

events.title: Book identity confounds the representation
events.summary: Style, era and translation make passages from one book alike whatever symbol they hold, and that shared part drives the clusters.

events.title: Centre the embeddings by book before clustering
events.summary: Subtract each book's mean embedding and normalise again, and compare it with masking the symbol word on one shared sample.
events.reason: The baseline grouped books, so the part every passage of a book shares had to be removed before reading anything into the clusters.

events.title: Four deconfounding variants on one shared sample
events.summary: Baseline, symbol masked, book-centred and both, each with its own map and clusters on the same occurrences.
events.hypothesis: Removing each book's mean embedding should reduce how much a cluster depends on one book.

events.title: Book-centring cut the largest-book share from 74 % to 57 %
events.summary: Cross-book clusters rose from 5 to 24 and the silhouette did not drop. Masking the symbol word changed the book share little.

events.title: Glossaries and indexes formed false cross-book clusters
events.summary: One of the largest book-centred cross-book clusters was built from Bulfinch's glossary entries, not from narrative.

events.title: Remove paratext before clustering
events.summary: Cut contents, glossaries, notes and indexes from the books and keep an audit of every removal.

events.title: Only a person's review may name a cluster
events.summary: Clusters are ranked for review and stay numbers until someone has read the passages; rejections are recorded too.
events.reason: A cluster spanning several books is a recurring context worth reading, not proof of a shared meaning.

events.title: Expand the corpus to 101 books across 12 traditions
events.summary: Keep the same 20 symbols and grow the corpus from 10 to 101 public-domain books, so the comparison stays controlled.

events.title: The larger corpus gave broader but weaker structure
events.summary: Book-centred, the largest-book share fell to 36 % and 87 of 114 clusters span several books, while the silhouette fell to 0.31.

events.title: Four embedding models compared by their nearest neighbours
events.summary: MiniLM, bge-base, e5-base and gte-base on the same 21,898 book-centred passages, scored by the share of each passage's 10 nearest neighbours from the same book or with the same symbol.
events.hypothesis: A larger embedding model places passages more by symbol and less by book.

events.title: Larger models gained about four points on same-symbol neighbours
events.summary: gte-base put 31 % same-symbol passages among the neighbours against 26 % for MiniLM; same-book neighbours fell from 26 % to 22-25 %.

events.title: Keep all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for the published atlas
events.reason: The gain is small next to the book effect, and the clustering settings were chosen for MiniLM; they should change only after the review.

events.title: Which v4 clusters survive a person's review?
How often is a symbol word used literally rather than symbolically?
events.summary: Needs a hand-labelled sample of occurrences; none exists yet.

events.title: Open the concept layer with Concept Journey
events.summary: Follow one concept at a time through stories, philosophy, Riksdag speeches and the AI Act; the constellation stays as the exploring view.
events.reason: A reader can follow one idea across four kinds of text more easily than read the whole constellation at once.

events.title: Record why the system changes in an append-only Idea Lineage journal
events.summary: Ideas, decisions, experiments, findings and questions are stored as short structured events; prompts and conversations never are.
events.reason: Data lineage says where data came from; the reasons behind a change of direction were not written down anywhere.

events.title: Optimise the agent workflow in six areas
events.summary: CI duplication, verification scope, skill routing, resource checks, workspace lifecycle and responsibility-based extraction. Verification levels live in docs/development.md and scripts/verify.mjs.

events.title: No automatic deployment, and missing data stays absent
events.summary: Financial, workforce, contracts, repository and issuer data that cannot be fetched is left out rather than filled in. Named legal findings require human approval before they are shown.

events.title: Withdraw the observatories from the site

Every old address and /companies/* redirects to #what-does-it-even-mean. frontend/src/{compliance,companies,job-intelligence} stay unrouted because compliance:check and jobs:check read them.

Results with status finding may appear on the site; the rest stay in docs/cluster-batches.md.

events.title: Job-ad language 2010 to 2025: passion +72 %, creativity +21 %, competence -19 %, stress -34 %
events.summary: Per 1,000 words with the occupation mix held fixed, over 23 archives: 11,291,650 ads and 8,736,050 distinct texts. Ads grew from 132 to 445 words.

events.title: Future-oriented Riksdag speeches rose from 17.8 % (1994) to 21.9 %
events.summary: Within future talk, security rose from 27 % to 39 % (break 2017) and crisis from 10 % to 18 % (break 2008). Limitation: the first run skipped session 1999/2000 through a six-digit regex, fixed in 71761a09, and 21.9 % is the partial year 2026.

events.title: Riksdag moral-foundation shares stay unpublished until the owner's review passes the gate
events.summary: The owner labels tmp/mf-review.csv (300 sentence passages); python -m ml.moral.riksdag gate compares the single-rater F1 with the majority-gold English F1 before score may run.
events.reason: the English tagger sits only at the human ceiling, so Swedish output needs its own check

events.title: Moral-foundation raw text stays local; only figures and derived features go to R2
events.summary: warehouse/raw/philosophy_moral (MFRC Reddit text, GPL eMFD, ETHICS) and features/philosophy/moral/run are LOCAL_ONLY in warehouse_store.py.

events.title: The foundation tagger reaches macro-F1 0.32 against a human ceiling of 0.27
events.summary: In-domain random split, one annotator as reference; annotator-vs-annotator 0.27 (alpha 0.08 to 0.31). eMFD baseline 0.04 to 0.22. ETHICS with gemma: kappa 0.50 to 0.84, every subset above the shuffle null.

events.title: One shared experiment core with a registry of candidate, champion and rejected runs
events.summary: ml/experiments/: contract, leak-free splits, shared measures, frozen acceptance rules in configs/experiments/*.yaml, embedding cache per text hash, checkpoints and a heavy lock. Promotion, rollback and reinstate are explicit commands; the weekly job never promotes.

events.title: The GitHub runner is the deciding machine for champion promotions
events.summary: Stored registries for philosophy, symbolic and debates were replaced by the runner's repro registries (local ones kept as registry-local-2026-10-29.json). Champions: f367c26d, a224a175, b33f92b1; jobs unchanged.
events.reason: local and runner runs differ by a few hundredths in UMAP/HDBSCAN metrics, which is within the frozen margins, so one machine has to decide

events.title: The runner is deterministic; local versus runner is the drift
events.summary: Two runner finals for philosophy, symbolic and debates matched exactly (41051018576, 41051992370, 41073947884). Decisions differed from local in every domain.

events.title: Anything that passes its gate may be shown on Cluster Visuals
events.summary: GatedModels lists mlkit targets whose pre-declared gate passed; a card whose gate failed keeps the failure and loses its data file (ml/mlkit/promote.py).

events.title: government_defeat failed the amended gate: 0.646 against title-procedure flags at 0.661
events.summary: Difference -0.015 (-0.041 to +0.010), run 20261101-0258. It is off Cluster Visuals. polarization passed its speaker-shuffle retest: 33 of 33 sessions, mean AUC 0.649.

events.title: Dimensionality-reduction benchmark not adopted; the atlas stays on v2
events.summary: umap10 with exact kNN gave 87 versus 83 stable clusters, under the 1.10 clear-win line; openTSNE map kNN15 0.278 versus 0.094 for UMAP. Local run, docs/cluster-atlas.md.

events.title: Atlas v2: Ledoit-Wolf whitening chosen by a pre-declared rule, 87 of 137 clusters stable over 5 seeds
events.summary: 77,753 passages from six corpora in one MiniLM-L12 space with per-corpus whitening (purity 0.977 to 0.775, translation match 0.996). Links need BH q < 0.05 and a block-bootstrap lower bound above 1: 71 of 3,685.

events.title: Publication refuses a 30 % row drop on files of 100+ rows
events.summary: Override with PORTFOLIO_ALLOW_ROW_DROP. A partly missing dbt group blocks, --only publish keeps group completeness, and the heartbeat compares published_at.

events.title: Worker AI routes refuse foreign origins and answer 503 without the limiter
Every page is published, in one charcoal theme
